Brennan Investment Group, a private real estate investment firm specializing in the acquisition, development and management of industrial facilities across the United States, has announced the recapitalization of two portfolios containing 22 buildings and totaling 1,176,122 square feet located in Moorestown, N.J., and Nashville. The transaction marks Brennan’s third recapitalization of the Moorestown buildings. The newly combined portfolio includes 20 buildings in Moorestown and two buildings in Nashville spanning approximately 116 acres.
The portfolio is 94 percent leased and consists of highly functional class B industrial buildings, with an average suite size of approximately 16,100 square feet, serving a diverse mix of industrial tenants in two of the nation’s strongest infill industrial markets.
